card.name: Test-to-reference ratio colon in interaction tables
card.fires_on: The colon in "geometric mean ratio of test: reference" in drug interaction table footnotes, where the next word is "reference". Weaker on "to" or a drug name ending in comparisons against a control or the drug given alone.
